title: Tiger 1200 Rally Explorer (Pro Spec)
description: The Triumph Tiger 1200 Rally Explorer (Pro Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1200cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
